title.narrative: BR Municipal APL: Teresina Enhancing Municipal Governance and Quality of Life Project

description.narrative: The Teresina Enhancing Municipal Governance and Quality of Life Project for Brazil's objectives are to (i) modernize and improve the management capacity of Teresina Municipal Government (PMT) in the financial, urban, environmental, service-delivery, and economic development fields; and (ii) improve the quality of life of the low-income population of the Lagoas do Norte region of the city. The project was divided into the following three components: (i) municipal management modernization, city development, and project management; (ii) integrated urban-environmental development in Lagoas do Norte; and (iii) social and economic development in Lagoas do Norte. The project's first component includes activities to: (i) consolidate PMT's recent efforts to improve its financial and budget management processes and capacity; (ii) improve service delivery, with a focus on water supply and sanitation and education (for the former by bringing PMT into compliance with the new federal WSS law; for the latter through the development and implementation of a new education policy and strategy for the city); (iii) improve urban and environmental management capacity and processes; (iv) lead the process and dialogue of the city's local economic and social development vision and strategy; and (v) project management support. The project's second component encompasses the undertaking of urban-environmental improvement interventions in the Lagoas do Norte region of the city, including: water supply, wastewater collection and treatment, macro and micro-drainage, recuperation of the natural environmental, urban upgrading, rehabilitation and implementation of parks and leisure spaces, local road network improvements, resettlement of beneficiary families from areas of risk, and implementing housing improvements. The project's third component comprises social and economic development interventions in the Lagoas do Norte region, including: strengthening community associations and groups, provision of improved social services (health, education services), environmental education, employment and wealth creation programs, and community mobilization and participation for works interventions.

The objectives of the project are to (i) modernize and improve the management capacity of Teresina Municipal Government in the financial, urban, environmental, service-delivery, and economic development fields; and (ii) improve the quality of life of the low-income population of the Lagoas do Norte region of the city.

title.narrative: Increase the collection efficiency of municipal renevues as a result of activities implemented under the project

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved. This indicator was introduced as part of project restructuring in 2013, with a baseline of 2005 municipal revenues. Byproject closure computed revenue collections (tax and primary revenues, excluding transfers and extraordinary revenues) indicated a 437 percent real growth from the baseline, against 50 percent goal revised during the 2016 project restructuring as part of the additional financing.</p>

title.narrative: Number of families benefiting from upgrading/improvements to their current households

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded. By Project closure 766 households had benefitted from several house improvements, including toilet facilities, </p>
<p>Not achieved. Of the planned 58km of non-rural roads, only 28% (16.28km) were completed.</p>

title.narrative: Number of socio-environmental activities implemented in the projects area of intervention, including schools

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded. A cumulative 225 social activities were developed, exceeding the target. These include sports events, fairs, summer camps, community cultural events and music shows.</p>

<p>Partially achieved. By Project Closure, there were 71,784 people (out of 92,000) directly benefited from various urban upgrading, drainage, water and sanitation, and environmental restoration improvements under the Project in the neighborhoods of São Joaquim, Poti Velho, Olarias Mocambinho, Matadouro, Nova Brasilia, Parque Alvorada and Vila São Francisco.</p>

title.narrative: New household sewer connections constructed under the project

comment.narrative: <p>Partially achieved. Of the planned 14,000 connections, 8,848 were constructed by PMT under the Project.</p>

title.narrative: Increase in protected and recovered areas for leisure and collective use in the Project Area (m2/habitant)

comment.narrative: <p>Partially achieved. By project closure, 3.31 m2 per inhabitant were protected and recovered areas for leisure and collective use in the Lagoas do Norte. This represents a 66 percent achievement.</p>

title.narrative: People provided with access to improved sanitation facilities under the proj.

comment.narrative: <p>Not achieved. Of the planned 60,000 people to be provided with improved sanitation facilities, only 38% (22636) were achieved.</p>

title.narrative: Improve the municipality's aggregate PEFA score

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved. The computation of the aggregate PEFA score at Project Closure for Teresina PMT is B. There was an advance in themanagement of PMT from 2005 onwards since the average value reached at that time was C+. Despite the decrease in the budget predictability (in part due to the context of the COVID19 pandemic) and inspection and external auditing arrangements indicators, PMT has significantly improved in transparency, Public Financial Management aspects, including budget and revenue management, and accounting framework.</p>

title.narrative: Reduction in the pollution levels of the lagoons in the Project Area (measured by dissolved oxygen levels)

comment.narrative: <p>Partially achieved. Target refers to measurements in Lagoons Cabrinha, Lourival, and Pantanal as defined during the AF preparation.</p>

title.narrative: Municipal compliance with federal WSS law:- preparation of WSS plan- creation/strengthening of regulating body- formalizationof service delivery contractual arrangement

baseline.value: No compliance with federal WSS law

comment.narrative:
<p>Achieved. The project was expected to support PMT in establishing a service delivery framework compliant with the Federal Water Supply and Sanitation Law, with a specific focus on developing the municipal water and sanitation plan, operationalizing the regulatory entity, and ensuring a service provision contract consistent with federal law. By January 2013, the restructuring and capacity-building plan for regulation had been completed and was under implementation. The service delivery contract between the PMT and Piaui Water and Sanitation Company (AGESPISA) had been signed. With the development of the Drainage Plan and the WSS Plan, the indicator was assessed as achieved in October 2013.</p>

<p> </p>

<p> </p>

title.narrative: Municipal drainage master plan completed and operationalized

target.value: Master Plan Completed and Legislation Adopted

comment.narrative: <p>Achieved. An Urban Drainage Master Plan was developed prior to the 2013 restructuring and is being used by the PMT as the guiding instrument for urban drainage interventions in the city, including procedures for land allocation and use, and construction norms.</p>

title.narrative: Restructuring Plan for the Municipal Environmental Secretariat developed and priority actions implemented

comment.narrative: <p>Partially achieved. The restructuring plan for the municipal environmental secretariat was developed and outlined priority actions, mostly implemented by the project closure (office and field equipment upgrading, ToRs for polluting activities and administrative restructuring of the secretariat) , except for the expansion of the secretariat offices and the establishment of software for operational procedures.</p>

<p>Achieved. The following improvements to municipal management were implemented: i. Management Information system for administrative, financial, and human resource management ii. Internal control systems iii. Unified system for management of human resources iv. Electronic receipts system (to facilitate collecting of tax revenues</p>

title.narrative: Number of families living in at risk of environmental protection areas in the Lagoas do Norte Region resettled to new housing

comment.narrative: <p>Not achieved. This indicator was originally included as an intermediate indicator in the RF and moved to PDO indicator as part of the AF in 2016. A total of 1056 households (out of 2699) at risk or environmental preservation in areas 1, 2, and 3, were resettled as part of the project.</p>

title.narrative: Annual attendance levels of events in the Teatro do Boi

comment.narrative: <p>Exceeded. The average number of attendants in the last five years is 5,026, against the target of 5,000. This average took into account a 0 attendance in 2020 due to the COVID-19 restrictions. Without the 2020 attendances, the average is at 6,283.</p>

title.narrative: Gender aspects mainstreamed into the Municipal Violence Prevention Plan

title.narrative: Municipal revenue spent on staff costs
